level_id_bank.verdict: NOT HELD (watch). A descending triangle: supply 101.45-105.2 (operator horizontal + two falling lines + Aug/Oct highs) over a four-source floor 85.2-88.75 (rising line + red horizontal + rising long MA + Sep-Oct lows). Price at 89.4 sits on the floor under the MA pivot 92.7-93.3. Constructive only on a reclaim of 93.3; a daily close below 85.2 voids the floor.
level_id_bank.method: No labelled level-ID ladder. 20 horizontals pixel-detected and converted at 1D frame 08:46 IST: 18.278 px/INR off axis labels 120/66 (2-INR step), y->px = 120-(y-82)/18.278; the MA tags reproduce to <=0.05. Ladder solve over all line pairs (13-ratio preset + 0.236-0.786 retracements, 0.2% tol): best pair explained 3 lines, i.e. chance level on a 20-line chart -> NOT forced (LADDER-DRIFT-IS-ATTRIBUTION). Trendlines traced by red-pixel columns. Swing points from GENERATORS/_cache/historical_ohlc.csv (onboarded 261028).
